findings.text: The company was incorporated on 21 April 2011 and ceased on 4 December 2012, at an age of 1.6 years (593 days).
Companies House records show one current officer, a director, PERSON 237, appointed on 21 April 2011.
The accounts and confirmation statement are of unknown overdue status, and their next due dates and last made-up dates are not recorded.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner.
No charges are registered against the company.
The director, PERSON 237, has 3 other appointments, all of which are dissolved companies.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 287 (91000288) is dissolved, having ceased on 4 December 2012, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
